description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahalunuka, Ridimaliyadda, Badulla District    - Cad. Map No. 710022
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels of land in various locations. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status (all listed as "The State"), and other land-specific particulars. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
